## A minimal showcase document

This document exists purely to give `oxview::ox_view_docx()` something real
to preview - headings, a table, a plot, and a hyperlink, all produced by
knitting this file with **R Markdown**.

### A table

```{r}
knitr::kable(mtcars[1:5, 1:4])
```

### A plot

```{r}
plot(mtcars$wt, mtcars$mpg, main = "Weight vs mpg", xlab = "wt (1000 lbs)", ylab = "mpg")
```

### A hyperlink

See the [R Markdown documentation](https://rmarkdown.rstudio.com/) for more
on what this format can do.
